Scope and relation to earlier screens
This note refines the conditional 3kJ/kg loading,2.4kJ/kg unloading,5kJ/kg useful-cooling example in ROOT_STEAM_SERVICE_AND_DURABLE_COOLING_CONTRACTS_20261112.txt. It does not supply a new material cycle or machine and does not change any actually posted question. Earlier values were separate introduced screens, explicitly not a jointly qualified point. They must not silently become a consistent isothermal4C/40C material cycle. A distributed regenerator can have different heat-port temperatures; its actual entropy integral replaces that specialization. No blanket exclusion of caloric cooling, other representations or vapor compression follows.

Whole useful-stream entropy
For10kW cooling of water12Cto7C, introduced constant cp4180J/kg/K gives0.478469kg/s water. The removed entropy is mdot*cp*ln(285.15/280.15). If air actually warms35Cto40C while receiving all10kW plus imported work W, its entropy increase is (10000+W)/5*ln(313.15/308.15). Equating these gives a reversible whole-stream minimumW990.674W/COP10.0941. This differs from the earlierCOP11.0808 isothermal35C infinite-sink bound because a finite air stream warms5K. Neither is a heat exchanger or qualified cycle. No external thermal reservoir, stored strain or cold preparation is credited.

Internal work cannot be chosen independently of heat ports
Specialize to one material loop whose net cold heat q=5kJ/kg/cycle enters isothermally at4C and whose hot heat leaves isothermally atTh. The second law gives
  w_internal >= q*(Th/Tc-1), Tc=277.15K.
If loading is3kJ/kg, recoverable unloading cannot exceed3-w_internal.
